name: 77027 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77027 (Houston) has 246 nonprofit organizations. 96 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 81 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77027 (Houston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77027 (Houston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 81 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
